name: FlexyPress Scroll to Top
author: rezamas

sections.description:
FlexyPress Scroll to Top is a lightweight and user-friendly WordPress plugin that enhances website navigation by adding a fully customizable “Scroll to Top” button. This plugin offers a wide range of customization options, allowing users to tailor the button’s appearance and functionality to fit their website’s design and user experience.

Features

  • Customizable button text or the ability to use a custom icon.
  • Adjustable color and background color.
  • Options to modify the button size, position, and border radius for a perfect fit.
  • Smooth scrolling animation for a seamless experience.
  • Compatibility with all modern WordPress themes and minimal impact on page performance.
  • FlexyPress Scroll to Top is ideal for improving user engagement and accessibility by making it effortless for visitors to navigate back to the top of the page. Perfect for blogs, e-commerce sites, and content-heavy websites.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin require any plugin to be installed?

No.

Can I use this plugin with any themes?

Yes, you can. This plugin works with any themes without any limitation.
